name: File Ingress Response Playbook
description: Automated response for suspicious file creation or data exfiltration events. Triggered by Splunk Sysmon EventCode 11 alert. Hashes file, checks VirusTotal, quarantines if malicious, notifies analyst.
trigger: Splunk Webhook Alert (Sysmon EventCode 11 - File Created)

workflow_steps.description: Receives file creation alert from Splunk
Normalises file path and hash values
Classifies file risk based on extension and path
workflow_steps.logic: if .exe/.ps1/.bat in suspicious path: HIGH, if .zip/.rar: MEDIUM, else: LOW

workflow_steps.description: Submits file SHA256 hash to VirusTotal for reputation check
Routes based on VirusTotal malicious score
Moves file to quarantine directory on affected host
Sends enriched alert with file details and response outcome
